description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior Claims Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisteredToExamine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExamineToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOKToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check recommendation and mark claim OK or Not OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOK" name="Claim marked OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOKToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OKToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimOK" name="Claim OK, claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OKToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisteredToExamine" name="" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExamineToWrite" name="" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToCheck" name="" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToGateway" name="" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOKToWrite" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OKToEnd" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOK" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimOK"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
